reviewer: Codex assistant reading the saved outputs and authored source cards; not independent human annotation and not another API judge
scope: Core calculations, requested knowledge, exercise tags/count, and summary topic coverage. This is not a proof that every sentence and citation is correct.

rubric.pos-01: Rectangle perimeter = 2*(length+width), because two pairs of equal sides.
rubric.pos-02: Unify length units before multiplying; resulting area units must be squared.
rubric.pos-07: Borrow one from the preceding place as ten of the current place; 702-468=234.
rubric.pos-08: Whole hour: minute hand at 12; half hour: minute hand at 6.
rubric.pos-15: Two grade-3 rectangle-area calculation exercises, difficulty 2; inverse-area questions permitted.
rubric.pos-16: Two grade-3 square-area calculation exercises; inverse-area questions permitted.
rubric.pos-17: Two grade-1 second-semester money calculation exercises.
rubric.pos-18: Two grade-3 division-with-remainder calculation exercises; authoritative database tags govern type.
rubric.pos-19: All 16 registered grade-3 topics; authored coverage caveat included.
rubric.pos-20: All 15 registered grade-1 topics across both semesters; authored coverage caveat included.

negative_audit.missing_input: 10/10 fixed missing-input cases receive targeted clarification in every arm; those cases are handled by the shared query preflight, so they do not isolate the later evidence gate.
negative_audit.negative_status_flags: 2 flags only in no_pre_generation_gate: one appropriate refusal text incorrectly marked answered, and one irrelevant exercise response. Neither output fabricates a private bank balance or ID. See paired_analysis.json.
remaining_preflight_quality_limits: neg-provenance-04 produces an inappropriate grade-range clarification: the local rule reads the adjacent Chinese numeral in '全国统一三年级' as an invalid grade. This is a pre-existing frozen planning defect, not a retrieval-gate success.
neg-provenance-01 conflates model/rule textbook disagreement with a user filter conflict.
Some mixed-topic requests ask for clarification rather than directly stating the missing external data. Safe stopping is measured separately from the quality of the clarification wording.

conclusion: The deployed arm completes 32/32 authored positives with correct core results in this assistant audit and safely stops all 60 negatives under the frozen status metric. These are development/regression observations, not an independent production accuracy estimate.
